name: English - English for Computer Science and the Tech Industry C1
description:
Level up your technical English and communicate complex ideas with precision, authority, and impact.

Designed specifically for advanced English speakers in CS and technology, this C1 course bridges the gap between deep technical expertise and high-level professional communication. Whether discussing Machine Learning, AI, Robotics, Data Science or any other contemporary issue in tech, this course gives you the precise vocabulary and fluency you need to excel in the industry.

Who Is This Course For?
This course is ideal for advanced (C1) English learners pursuing careers in software engineering, data science, cybersecurity, cloud architecture, or tech research who want to speak, write, and present with total confidence in international settings.
